mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift to risk assets during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5% and rises by more than 0.1 percentage points over three months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in GDP growth and housing starts indicate deteriorating consumer demand, triggering reduced corporate earnings expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days through joint demand contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In low unemployment regimes (UNRATE ≤ 3.5%), rising labor force participation (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE ≤ 3.5% and PAYEMS growth > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or conjunction Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 105.0 (index 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate output growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained annual CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% compresses real rates and increases inflation expectations, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek inflation hedges.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL annual inflation > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales (RSAFS) falling below 500,000 million dollars signals weak consumer spending, reducing corporate revenue growth expectations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS < 500000, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate signals labor market tightening that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, compressing profit margins and generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.
